chunks: And made them a precedent and example for posterity.

key_terms.سَلَفاً: A precedent, forerunner, or those who went before
key_terms.لِلْآخِرِينَ: For the later generations or posterity
key_terms.مَثَلاً: An example, model, or pattern (for imitation or warning)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean for a group to be a 'precedent and example' for later generations in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as describing the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his Ahl al-Bayt as a lasting legacy (salfan) and exemplary model (mathalan) for subsequent generations. It underscores the continuity of divine guidance, where their spiritual and moral stature serves as a permanent reference point for truth and righteousness.
